purpose: Define teacher-card assembly with visible curriculum, PEP and diagnostic evidence status.
resolution_order: Resolve China national curriculum stage and comparison curriculum independently.
If PEP revised series is selected, resolve exact grade/semester/unit from the authoritative sequence and unit-concept mapping, then apply corrections.
Load below-unit PEP detail only at its registered evidence level and resolve rollout separately when locality/term use is relevant.
For a selected US state, use the registered state overlay when available; do not silently substitute Common Core as the state requirement.
Resolve locators, representations and teaching moves.
Apply diagnostic overlays, canonicalise misconception aliases and deduplicate.
Resolve canonical diagnostic evidence class separately from curriculum evidence.
Apply localization and assemble visible sections/status labels.

teacher_facing_sections.rule: Show curriculum expectation/placement, not inferred classroom practice.
When PEP is selected, show verified grade/semester/unit. Show subsection/page detail only where separately verified.
Show development without implying same-numbered-grade equivalence.
State system-specific use only when evidenced; otherwise call it an instructional option.
Recommend moves for mathematical/evidence reasons, not as national traits.
Keep rationale separate from curriculum requirements.
Describe possible reasoning patterns and display evidence class; never diagnose from one answer.
Label as a diagnostic probe, not a formal/validated assessment; require explanation or a second probe.
Give one practical option for the Chinese curriculum context without ranking systems.
Show the smallest useful source set, locators and status.

unit_sequence_verified.zh-CN: 人教版年级/学期/单元已核实

below_unit_secondary_verified.zh-CN: 小节/课时有当前资料支持
below_unit_secondary_verified.en: Subsection/lesson detail supported by current materials

below_unit_not_publicly_verified.zh-CN: 单元已核实；更细内容未公开核实
below_unit_not_publicly_verified.en: Unit verified; finer detail not publicly verified

designed_series_not_rollout_verified.zh-CN: 修订版编排已核实；实际使用按地区和学期确认
designed_series_not_rollout_verified.en: Revised-series design verified; actual use depends on locality and term

artifact_not_publicly_recovered.zh-CN: 教材身份已确认；ISBN未公开核实
artifact_not_publicly_recovered.en: Artifact identified; ISBN not publicly verified

direct_empirical_language_mediated.zh-CN: 有直接研究支持（受语言因素影响）
direct_empirical_language_mediated.en: Direct research support with language-related scope limits

direct_empirical_broad_construct_or_mech.zh-CN: 相关直接研究支持（具体表述需谨慎）
direct_empirical_broad_construct_or_mech.en: Related direct research; exact wording is narrower

evidence_synthesis_or_guidance.zh-CN: 研究综述或证据指南支持

curriculum_inferred_with_broader_support.zh-CN: 课堂诊断提示（有相关研究支持）
curriculum_inferred_with_broader_support.en: Instructional probe with broader research support

status_gates.research_required: Do not show as established fact.
status_gates.pep_unit_verified: May show grade/semester/unit as revised-series placement.
status_gates.pep_below_unit_secondary: May show with source-quality qualification; do not imply publisher-primary verification.
status_gates.pep_rollout_query_dependent: Do not infer current local use without locality/publisher/term evidence.
status_gates.curriculum_inferred_misconception: Show only as a possible misunderstanding/probe.
status_gates.direct_empirical_misconception: May say research supports the reasoning pattern within source scope, but not prevalence or diagnostic certainty.

jurisdiction_rules: Use 中国N年级 for PEP revised-series placement only when the verified PEP sequence supports it; national curriculum requirements still use learning-stage labels where appropriate.
Use 英格兰 Year N for England.
Use 美国 Common Core Grade N and label it baseline when no state is selected.
Use California/Texas state labels and standards where mapped.
Never translate foreign grade labels into Chinese grade equivalence.
diagnostic_rules: Require at least two pieces of evidence before recording a likely misconception.
Separate conceptual, procedural, fluency, representation and language difficulties.
For bilingual pupils, re-probe with simpler language or Chinese when wording may be the barrier.
Recheck the same structure with different surface details.
copy_rules: Use short headings and plain explanations.
Avoid marketing language, slogans, hype and AI-style filler.
Prefer compare, show, explain, ask, check, represent, calculate and justify.
integrity_checks_before_render: Every factual system statement has a source or explicit evidence status.
Every PEP placement resolves through the revised sequence, never a legacy sequence.
Below-unit PEP content is not shown above its verified evidence level.
Every diagnostic misconception displays its canonical evidence class.
Every diagnostic item is visibly a probe, not a validated test.
No national PEP adoption/rollout is inferred from the series sequence.
State selections do not silently fall back to Common Core as state requirements.
